5bb095ac8df5c8643be2109317e2465d5f9e0dbc.description: Bali’s First Ice Season at BLOCK42, Nuanu For the first time in Bali, BLOCK42, Nuanu welcomes a spectacular season of live ice shows, bringing together professional figure skating, circus performance, theatre and immersive visual technology on a real ice rink built especially for the occasion. The season features two large-scale productions: Aladdin and the Famous Stories from 1001 Nights on Ice (2 shows: 31 October 2026 starting at 16:00 and starting 19:00) takes audiences into the legendary world of Scheherazade, Aladdin, Ali Baba and Sinbad. Expect breathtaking skating, acrobatics, daring jumps and spins, fire juggling, hula hoops, magic tricks, spectacular costumes and large-scale video projections inspired by the atmosphere of the East. Alice in Wonderland on Ice (2 shows: 01 November 2026 starting at 13:00 and starting 16:00) reimagines Lewis Carroll’s timeless story through figure skating, circus artistry and immersive digital scenography. Alice and the unforgettable characters of Wonderland come to life through complex choreography, acrobatics and striking visual effects that transform the venue into a surreal fantasy world. Two stories. Two spectacular productions. One ice rink in the heart of Bali. A unique live experience for families, children and adults, combining the elegance of figure skating with the energy of contemporary circus and the magic of theatre. How to Choose Your Show and Seats The performances are available on different dates and at different session times. Please select your preferred session when purchasing your ticket. Each session corresponds to a specific performance, date and show — Aladdin and the Famous Stories from 1001 Nights on Ice or Alice in Wonderland on Ice. After selecting your session, you can use the venue seating plan to choose your preferred seating area and available seats. Please check the show title, date and session time carefully before completing your booking, as different sessions may feature different productions. Children Policy Children under 12 years old must be accompanied by a parent or responsible adult aged 18 or over. Children aged 0–4 may attend with a Kids Ticket. This ticket does not include a separate seat, and the child must sit on the lap of the accompanying adult during the performance. Children aged 5 years and above require a regular ticket with their own seat. Ketentuan Anak Anak di bawah usia 12 tahun wajib didampingi oleh orang tua atau orang dewasa yang bertanggung jawab berusia 18 tahun ke atas. Anak usia 0–4 tahun dapat masuk dengan Kids Ticket. Tiket ini tidak termasuk tempat duduk terpisah, dan anak harus duduk di pangkuan orang dewasa yang mendampingi selama pertunjukan. Anak usia 5 tahun ke atas wajib memiliki tiket reguler dengan tempat duduk sendiri. fe12fce99cffaa563aeb7c429ca50c9753f09964.description: Dear Earthlings, Rituals matter. They set the tone, stir the mood, and give us a very good excuse to get together. And for our next one, we’re taking things a little further… On Saturday, 28th November alongside KAIS EYE MEDIA, RITUAL starts on the beach before moving into The Sunset Mansion, an ocean-facing villa, somewhere between a sunset gathering, a house party and the kind of night that accidentally turns into breakfast. And this time, we’re bringing a very special guest. MICHAEL MAYER (Kompakt) / DE Co-founder of the legendary German label Kompakt, Michael Mayer has spent more than three decades shaping the more curious, emotional and wonderfully unpredictable corners of electronic music. Producer, selector, label boss, obsessive music digger and, above all, a truly exceptional DJ. From his iconic Immer mixes to Fabric, DJ-Kicks and countless dancefloors around the world, Michael has built a career around one simple idea we happen to agree with: Great music. Great people. The rest usually takes care of itself. And he won’t be alone… ANSTASCIA Formerly one half of BLOND:ISH and a serious force behind the decks. LUNAR DISCO Our French-Australian troublemakers, with releases on Crosstown Rebels, Defected and beyond. GADO GADO The minds behind La Piscine Électronique and plenty of other questionable good ideas. ANDY CHUNES PNNY crew representative and certified record selector. JULIA TIPSY Grooves, grooves and probably a few more grooves. SoFi Flying the Swiss flag and bringing a little Alpine mischief to the tropics. And perhaps a few surprises along the way… We start early. We finish late. Possibly very early and for breakfast. Sunset. DJs. Food. Drinks. Ocean. Bare feet strongly encouraged. Good behaviour entirely optional. TICKETS 100 FREE GUESTLISTS will be released through our WhatsApp group. First come, first served — earthlings move fast. Get your own room inside the villa — private space, private bathroom and your little headquarters for the night. IDR 10M minimum bar spend Includes 10 tickets. (Additional guests at the regular ticket price) Come early for the sunset. Stay for Michael Mayer. Leave whenever your body tells you the ritual is complete. RITUAL MATTERS. JOIN THE TRIBE.
